summary: Phase 3 consolidation testing complete. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass, covering new GET /api/cell/mission, /autonomy, /jr endpoints plus regression on 16 existing reads + all 4 mutations (approvals decide, map add-node, set-truth, mission advance). No mongo _id leaked. Frontend: rebuilt Home renders MissionStrip (with correct codename/mode/governance/truth), FatherAlerts with pending ap-1 (click → /governance and pre-selects approval in Context Inspector), separate identity-cell (OBSERVE) and identity-jr (CONTEMPLATING) cards, panel-autonomy (mode CONTROLLED, ALLOWED + REQUIRES FATHER lists), panel-next-focus (3 wants w-1..w-3 with FATHER badge on w-1 and w-3, none on w-2), metric-workers = 3 (non-zero). MissionStrip verified globally on all 9 routes. DEMO banner visible, CELL console returns scripted 'THE MAP IS THE TRUTH' reply on 'map' input, Cmd+K palette opens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /cell/map/nodes/{id}/truth passes `truth` as a raw query param instead of a Pydantic body — works but inconsistent with other mutations. Minor.

record_event/hhmmss uses only H:M:S with no date; events list is not sorted by real timestamp, so 'events.slice(-10).reverse()' on Home depends on insertion order. Acceptable for demo, but consider adding created_at ISO for ordering.
cellApi.safe() swallows errors and returns fallback silently — good for UX but hides backend regressions. Consider surfacing a badge when a fetch fails.
CellContext refresh() is only called on mount; after mutations (approve, add-node, advance) the frontend must call refresh() explicitly — verify each page does so (out of scope for this iteration).
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/cell/reseed once during testing to restore ap-1 to PENDING after mutation tests approved it. State is now clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stateful MongoDB; tests mutate ap-1 → APPROVED. After running pytest, call POST /api/cell/reseed to restore original ap-1 PENDING state so the Father Alerts row is visible on Home. All Phase-3 data-testids are: mission-strip, mission-codename, mission-mode, mission-governance, mission-truth, father-alerts, father-alert-ap-1, identity-cell, identity-jr, panel-autonomy, autonomy-mode, panel-next-focus, wants-next-{w-1|w-2|w-3}, metric-workers, command-center.
